title: चतुःसप्तत्यधिकद्विशततमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Ravana rides out in his golden chariot and conjures illusory Rakshasas and false Ramas. Matali brings Indra's chariot to Rama, who mounts it and at last slays Ravana with the Brahma weapon, burning his body so that not even ashes remain.
summary.kn: ರಾವಣನು ಸುವರ್ಣರಥದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೊರಬಂದು ಮಾಯಾರಾಕ್ಷಸರನ್ನೂ ಸುಳ್ಳು ರಾಮರನ್ನೂ ಸೃಷ್ಟಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಮಾತಲಿ ಇಂದ್ರರಥವನ್ನು ಶ್ರೀರಾಮನಿಗೆ ತರುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಅದನ್ನೇರಿ ಶ್ರೀರಾಮನು ಕೊನೆಗೆ ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಾಸ್ತ್ರದಿಂದ ರಾವಣನನ್ನು ಕೊಲ್ಲುತ್ತಾನೆ, ಬೂದಿಯೂ ಉಳಿಯದಂತೆ ಅವನ ದೇಹ ಸುಡುತ್ತದೆ.
summary.hi: रावण अपने स्वर्ण रथ पर निकलकर माया से राक्षस और झूठे राम रचता है। मातलि श्रीराम के लिए इन्द्र का रथ लाते हैं, जिस पर चढ़कर श्रीराम अन्ततः ब्रह्मास्त्र से रावण को मार डालते हैं, और उसका शरीर ऐसे जलता है कि राख भी नहीं बचती।
summary.te: రావణుడు బంగారు రథంపై బయలుదేరి మాయా రాక్షసులను, కపట రాములను సృష్టిస్తాడు. మాతలి ఇంద్రరథాన్ని శ్రీరామునికి తెస్తాడు; దానిపై ఎక్కి శ్రీరాముడు చివరకు బ్రహ్మాస్త్రంతో రావణుని సంహరిస్తాడు, బూడిద కూడా మిగలకుండా అతని దేహం కాలిపోతుంది.
summary.ta: ராவணன் தன் பொற்தேரில் புறப்பட்டு மாய அரக்கர்களையும் போலி ராமர்களையும் படைக்கிறான். மாதலி ஸ்ரீராமருக்கு இந்திரனின் தேரைக் கொணர, அதில் ஏறிய ஸ்ரீராமர் இறுதியில் ப்ரஹ்மாஸ்திரத்தால் ராவணனைக் கொல்ல, சாம்பலும் எஞ்சாமல் அவன் உடல் எரிகிறது.
summary.ml: സ്വർണ്ണരഥത്തിൽ രാവണൻ പുറപ്പെടുന്നു; മായയാൽ വ്യാജ രാക്ഷസന്മാരെയും വ്യാജരാമന്മാരെയും അദ്ദേഹം സൃഷ്ടിക്കുന്നു. മാതലി ഇന്ദ്രന്റെ രഥം രാമന്റെ അടുത്തേക്ക് കൊണ്ടുവരുന്നു; അതിൽ കയറി രാമൻ ബ്രഹ്മാസ്ത്രംകൊണ്ട് രാവണനെ ഒടുവിൽ വധിക്കുന്നു; ചാരംപോലും ശേഷിക്കാത്തവിധം ശരീരം ദഹിപ്പിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 3.274; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Apr 11 2022

verses.text: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

meaning.en: Markandeya said:

verses.text:
ततः क्रुद्धो दशग्रीवः प्रिये पुत्रे निपातिते ।
निर्ययौ रथमास्थाय हेमरत्नविभूषितम् ॥

meaning.en: Then Ravana, enraged that his dear son had been struck down, went out in a chariot adorned with gold and jewels.

verses.text:
संवृतो राक्षसैर्घोरैर्विविधायुधपाणिभिः ।
अभिदुद्राव रामं स पोथयन्हरियूथपान् ॥

meaning.en: Surrounded by terrible rakshasas with weapons of many kinds in their hands, he charged at Rama, crushing monkey leaders.

verses.text:
तमाद्रवन्तं संक्रुद्धं मैन्दनीलनलाङ्गदाः ।
हनूमाञ्जाम्बवांश्चैव ससैन्याः पर्यवारयन् ॥

meaning.en: As he charged in fury, Mainda, Nila, Nala, Angada, Hanuman, and Jambavan, with their forces, surrounded him.

verses.text:
ते दशग्रीवसैन्यं तदृक्षवानरयूथपाः ।
द्रुमैर्विध्वंसयां चक्रुर्दशग्रीवस्य पश्यतः ॥

meaning.en: Those leaders of bears and monkeys destroyed Ravana's army with trees as he watched.

verses.text:
ततः स्वसैन्यमालोक्य वध्यमानमरातिभिः ।
मायावी व्यदधान्मायां रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः ॥

meaning.en: Then seeing his army being slain by enemies, Ravana, lord of the rakshasas and master of illusion, worked a magic.

verses.text:
तस्य देहाद्विनिष्क्रान्ताः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः ।
राक्षसाः प्रत्यदृश्यन्त शरशक्त्यृष्टिपाणयः ॥

meaning.en: From his body rakshasas appeared by hundreds and thousands, with arrows, spears, and lances in their hands.

verses.text:
तान्रामो जघ्निवान्सर्वान्दिव्येनास्त्रेण राक्षसान् ।
अथ भूयोऽपि मायां स व्यदधाद्राक्षसाधिपः ॥

meaning.en: Rama killed all those rakshasas with a divine weapon, and the lord of the rakshasas then made another illusion.

verses.text:
कृत्वा रामस्य रूपाणि लक्ष्मणस्य च भारत ।
अभिदुद्राव रामं च लक्ष्मणं च दशाननः ॥

meaning.en: Making the likenesses of Rama and Lakshmana, O Bharata, the ten-faced one rushed at Rama and Lakshmana.

verses.text:
ततस्ते राममर्छन्तो लक्ष्मणं च क्षपाचराः ।
अभिपेतुस्तदा राजन्प्रगृहीतोच्चकार्मुकाः ॥

meaning.en: Then those night-wanderers, bearing Rama's form, and Lakshmana's, attacked, king, with their great bows raised.

verses.text:
तां दृष्ट्वा राक्षसेन्द्रस्य मायामिक्ष्वाकुनन्दनः ।
उवाच रामं सौमित्रिरसंभ्रान्तो बृहद्वचः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing that illusion of the rakshasa lord, the son of Sumitra, delight of the Ikshvakus, said calmly to Rama a weighty word:

verses.text:
जहीमान्राक्षसान्पापानात्मनः प्रतिरूपकान् ।
जघान रामस्तांश्चान्यानात्मनः प्रतिरूपकान् ॥

meaning.en: "Kill these evil ones who imitate you." Rama killed them, and the others who copied himself.

verses.text:
ततो हर्यश्वयुक्तेन रथेनादित्यवर्चसा ।
उपतस्थे रणे रामं मातलिः शक्रसारथिः ॥

meaning.en: Then Matali, Indra's charioteer, came to Rama in the battle with a chariot yoked to bay horses, bright as the sun.

verses.text: मातलिरुवाच

meaning.en: Matali said:

verses.text:
अयं हर्यश्वयुग्जैत्रो मघोनः स्यन्दनोत्तमः ।
अनेन शक्रः काकुत्स्थ समरे दैत्यदानवान् ।
शतशः पुरुषव्याघ्र रथोदारेण जघ्निवान् ॥

meaning.en: "This is the victorious best chariot of the mighty Indra, yoked with bay horses. With this great chariot, Kakutstha, Indra killed Daityas and Danavas in battle by the hundred, tiger among men.

verses.text:
तदनेन नरव्याघ्र मया यत्तेन संयुगे ।
स्यन्दनेन जहि क्षिप्रं रावणं मा चिरं कृथाः ॥

meaning.en: So, tiger among men, with this chariot, which I drive carefully in battle, kill Ravana quickly; do not delay."

verses.text:
इत्युक्तो राघवस्तथ्यं वचोऽशङ्कत मातलेः ।
मायेयं राक्षसस्येति तमुवाच विभीषणः ॥

meaning.en: Thus addressed, Rama doubted Matali's truthful words, thinking, "This is the rakshasa's illusion," and Vibhishana said to him:

verses.text:
नेयं माया नरव्याघ्र रावणस्य दुरात्मनः ।
तदातिष्ठ रथं शीघ्रमिममैन्द्रं महाद्युते ॥

meaning.en: "This is not the illusion of the wicked Ravana, tiger among men. So mount this chariot of Indra quickly, radiant one."

verses.text:
ततः प्रहृष्टः काकुत्स्थस्तथेत्युक्त्वा विभीषणम् ।
रथेनाभिपपाताशु दशग्रीवं रुषान्वितः ॥

meaning.en: Then glad, Rama said "So be it" to Vibhishana, and in the chariot swiftly attacked Ravana in anger.

verses.text:
हाहाकृतानि भूतानि रावणे समभिद्रुते ।
सिंहनादाः सपटहा दिवि दिव्याश्च नानदन् ॥

meaning.en: As Ravana charged, all beings cried out in dismay, and in heaven lion roars and drums of the gods sounded.

verses.text:
स रामाय महाघोरं विससर्ज निशाचरः ।
शूलमिन्द्राशनिप्रख्यं ब्रह्मदण्डमिवोद्यतम् ॥

meaning.en: The night-wanderer hurled at Rama a very terrible spear, like Indra's thunderbolt, raised like Brahma's staff of punishment.

verses.text:
तच्छूलमन्तरा रामश्चिच्छेद निशितैः शरैः ।
तद्दृष्ट्वा दुष्करं कर्म रावणं भयमाविशत् ॥

meaning.en: Rama cut that spear in midair with sharp arrows, and seeing that hard feat, fear entered Ravana.

verses.text:
ततः क्रुद्धः ससर्जाशु दशग्रीवः शिताञ्शरान् ।
सहस्रायुतशो रामे शस्त्राणि विविधानि च ॥

meaning.en: Then furious, Ravana quickly shot sharp arrows and many kinds of weapons at Rama, by thousands and tens of thousands.

verses.text:
ततो भुशुण्डीः शूलांश्च मुसलानि परश्वधान् ।
शक्तीश्च विविधाकाराः शतघ्नीश्च शितक्षुराः ॥

meaning.en: Then he loosed bhushundis, spears, clubs, axes, spears of many shapes, and shataghnis with razor edges.

verses.text:
तां मायां विकृतां दृष्ट्वा दशग्रीवस्य रक्षसः ।
भयात्प्रदुद्रुवुः सर्वे वानराः सर्वतोदिशम् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing that distorted illusion of the rakshasa Ravana, all the monkeys fled in fear in every direction.

verses.text:
ततः सुपत्रं सुमुखं हेमपुङ्खं शरोत्तमम् ।
तूणादादाय काकुत्स्थो ब्रह्मास्त्रेण युयोज ह ॥

meaning.en: Then Rama took a fine arrow from his quiver, with fine feathers, a good point, and gold shaft, and fitted it with the Brahma weapon.

verses.text:
तं बाणवर्यं रामेण ब्रह्मास्त्रेणाभिमन्त्रितम् ।
जहृषुर्देवगन्धर्वा दृष्ट्वा शक्रपुरोगमाः ॥

meaning.en: The gods and gandharvas, led by Indra, were delighted to see that excellent arrow charged by Rama with the Brahma weapon.

verses.text:
अल्पावशेषमायुश्च ततोऽमन्यन्त रक्षसः ।
ब्रह्मास्त्रोदीरणाच्छत्रोर्देवगन्धर्वकिंनराः ॥

meaning.en: Because the enemy's Brahma weapon had been invoked, the gods, gandharvas, and kinnaras thought the rakshasa's life had little time left.

verses.text:
ततः ससर्ज तं रामः शरमप्रतिमौजसम् ।
रावणान्तकरं घोरं ब्रह्मदण्डमिवोद्यतम् ॥

meaning.en: Then Rama loosed that arrow of unmatched energy, which would end Ravana, terrible, like a raised staff of Brahma.

verses.text:
स तेन राक्षसश्रेष्ठः सरथः साश्वसारथिः ।
प्रजज्वाल महाज्वालेनाग्निनाभिपरिष्कृतः ॥

meaning.en: By it the best of rakshasas, with chariot, horses, and charioteer, blazed up, wrapped in a huge fire.

verses.text:
ततः प्रहृष्टास्त्रिदशाः सगन्धर्वाः सचारणाः ।
निहतं रावणं दृष्ट्वा रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा ॥

meaning.en: Then the gods with the gandharvas and charanas were delighted to see Ravana killed by Rama of untiring deeds.

verses.text:
तत्यजुस्तं महाभागं पञ्च भूतानि रावणम् ।
भ्रंशितः सर्वलोकेषु स हि ब्रह्मास्त्रतेजसा ॥

meaning.en: The five elements abandoned that glorious Ravana, for he was banished from all worlds by the energy of the Brahma weapon.

verses.text:
शरीरधातवो ह्यस्य मांसं रुधिरमेव च ।
नेशुर्ब्रह्मास्त्रनिर्दग्धा न च भस्माप्यदृश्यत ॥

meaning.en: The constituents of his body, flesh and blood, were burned away by the Brahma weapon, and not even ash was seen.
